parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the bastion host instance.
> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the instance ID.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the bastion host.
> For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

parameters.name: RuleId
parameters.description:
The ID of the authorization rule to enable.
> You can call the [ListRules](~~2758868~~) operation to query the rule ID.
